title: Onboarding: done with --agent, rename a to-do with the CLI
description: The onboarding briefing shows plantool done without --agent, which fails when another agent claimed the ticket. Agents also cannot change the text of a to-do without editing .plan by hand, which the briefing forbids. Add plantool ticket todo ID N --text, and fix the done line.

outcome.summary: Onboarding workflow shows done with --agent; plantool ticket todo ID N --text renames a to-do; CLI test added.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test 110 pass; pnpm run check ok; to-do rename tried in a throwaway project.
